decisions.rationale: The initial education review showed that comment tokens could pass the code checker. Later exact-byte review verified parser, behavior, and structure checks, and final approval retained this artifact hash.

The initial timed page lacked full pattern discrimination, learner-produced planning, executed checks, spoken complexity practice, and a real time box. Focused education review later approved those behaviors on the exact final chain.

The initial report correctly withheld delivery approval while exact QA, companion, timing, lock, and critic coverage were absent. Current evidence records and the regenerated lock close the critic-record portion without changing learner bytes.
The incomplete-submission retry defect was valid. Later exact-byte review verified that missing input uses no attempt and preserves the promised retry.
The broad objective-done mapping was unsupported. Later review verified informational objectives with activity-local evidence instead of false mastery marks.
The editor feedback surface did not meet the approved tab semantics. Later exact-byte review verified named native Problems and Output tabs and panels.
The recognition-only planning finding was valid. The focused education review approved the corrected assembled contract and two learner-entered edge cases with distinct reasons.
The interval-gap expiry defect was valid. The focused education review verified synchronous deadline checks, same-session stamps, and both completion orders before the final guard-order correction.
The final education review correctly found that failed settled checkpoints still received completion and credit. Subsequent approved bytes derive completion and credit from passing evidence.
The source panel's anecdote hook misuse was valid. Later approval retained the corrected exact bytes.
Current critic evidence was absent at the reviewed checkpoint. The exact-head critic records added by this non-author reconciliation address that evidence gap.
The learner-visible source-date mismatch was valid and the later approval retained the corrected current bytes.

The SME correctly found that compile-error and unchanged-starter Runs checked the deadline too late. The final SME recheck approved the guard as the first runCode operation and verified exact-deadline and delayed-callback refusal on the current hash.
